title: Fix: FileNode client usage silent on null sha256 case
description: The FileNode section allows sha256: null for legacy file FileNodes (lines 198-201), but the Client Usage section (lines 207-213) unconditionally says clients SHOULD compare digests. No guidance is given for when sha256 is null. Need to add: 'If sha256 is null, no integrity check is possible via this mechanism; clients SHOULD note this as an unverified download.'
close_reason: Added null-case guidance to FileNode Client Usage: directs clients to treat null sha256 as unverified, and restricts the mismatch check to non-null values.
